selectionPolicy: Purposefully chosen explanatory cases, not a random sample or an estimate from the displayed clips. Paired examples use the lowest rollout index showing the stated transition, without rerunning a policy failure. Every task rate includes all ten frozen initial states for its named stage. Revisions were developed after source/demo inspection; these are diagnostic reruns, not held-out causal estimates.
videoNote: Original full episode frames at 20 fps, including the initial frame and ten warmup steps. Agent view is left and wrist view is right. Inference waiting time is omitted. Success is the native environment predicate; automatic success termination does not imply an independent agent completion judgment.

pairs.title: Which compartment is “back”?
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: The latest revision identifies the back compartment between the two large side compartments. The earlier “narrow back compartment” revision remained at 0/10.

pairs.title: Identify the intended can
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: Color words distinguish the blue-and-yellow alphabet soup can from the other cans.

pairs.title: How far is “open”?
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: Adding “fully” makes the intended amount of drawer opening more explicit.

pairs.title: Specify the rack and bottle orientation
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: The revision names the upper rack and places the bottle base against its lower retaining rail.

pairs.title: Make both placements more specific
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: The mug goes in the center of the plate; the pudding goes immediately to its right.

pairs.title: A closer plate placement
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with failure → success in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: The latest instruction adds “close to its front edge.” Only 2/10 passed. The intervening 35 cm revision used the wrong stove reference point and remained at 0/10.

pairs.title: Clearer wording can still regress
pairs.selectionRule: Lowest rollout index with success → failure in these two frozen runs.
pairs.note: Adding “in the center” did not consistently improve this task: 5/10 became 4/10, with both improvements and regressions across paired initial states.

failureCases.title: Mistaking the cabinet for the stove
failureCases.note: The plate is pushed beside the wooden cabinet on the left; the actual single-burner stove is on the right. The agent declared visual completion at 259 steps, but the native predicate failed.
failureCases.selectionRule: Named diagnostic episode chosen after review; not a random sample.

failureCases.title: The plate remains short of the goal
failureCases.note: The agent used all 500 control steps and acknowledged the remaining gap. Offline replay places the plate center 1.82 cm beyond the goal’s front boundary.
failureCases.selectionRule: Named diagnostic episode chosen after review; not a random sample.
